text: Aos 65 minutos, o Redmond Rovers mudou seu jeito de jogar para tentar buscar o empate. Eles passaram a pressionar mais lá na frente, a jogar de forma mais direta e subiram a linha defensiva para chegar mais perto do gol adversário[#1190]. Embora a posse de bola tenha caído de 63% para 46%, o time criou chances mais perigosas, com o xG subindo de 0,22 para 0,87 — isso significa que as chances de gol ficaram bem maiores[#1190]. Já o Ironvale Athletic recuou na defesa e sofreu menos perigo depois dessa mudança[#1190].

- This change involved raising their defensive line higher (from 0.78 to 0.9 line height) and enhancing press intensity (from 0.82 to 1.0), aiming to regain possession closer to the opponent’s goal to create more immediate attacking opportunities [#1190].
- Despite this, their possession dropped (from 63.1% to 45.8%), but the team significantly increased threat metrics like expected goals (xG rising from 0.22 to 0.87) and box touches (from 5 to 12), indicating more direct attacks penetrating Ironvale Athletic’s low block defensive setup [#1190].
- Ironvale Athletic’s 5-3-2 formation with a deep defensive line and direct vertical passing enabled them to absorb Redmond's increases in press and directness, limiting their opponent’s effectiveness despite the increased risk in Redmond’s shape; this is further supported by Ironvale's lower xG conceded after the change (dropping from 0.43 to 0.16) [moment.team_styles][#1190].
